notes.title: Maintenance Update
Survival Mode
notes.content:
We are proud to present a much-demanded feature that allows you to play without friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37326385/c075a33208dc1ea24d97c5f16ada8cfcb5d5d7c4.png[/img]

No friends? We got you covered! You go straight into a Survival Game where you must defend a Gummy Bear from a horde of mechanical spiders. You can play solo or with up to 5 strangers.

You can still single out a player to play PvP and experience the legacy game mode or fight hordes of killer spiders at your discretion, the choice is yours, and the wait time is zero for maximal satisfaction!

notes.title: The end of first week giveaway
notes.content:
It came to an end and it was a hell of a week, so many games played, shots fired, people trying to cheat the system balancing patches and much more.
But today is the end off the giveaway and we are happy to announce the winners and their prises.
1st - [b]Perry the Platypus[/b] will receive a[u] 50€ steam gift card and a custom mug[/u] just for this event
2nd - [b]Teixeira[/b] will receive a [u]25€ steam gift card[/u]
3rd - [b]Zeder[/b] will receive a [u]10€ steam gift card[/u]

Thank you to all the people who participated, and lets keep playing. There is more good stuff to come so git gud
This was the leaderboard when the event ended
